summary: English company standard CP template: page 1 with a logo placeholder and the patient table, a summary of findings with a device yes or no table, clinician forms and a component table, CP summaries, and an appendix. The appendix covers questionnaires, VCPT, spectra and maps, TBR, indices, vigilance, asymmetry and coherence maps, ICA and channel ERPs, classifiers, microstates, stress, HRV and long treatment texts.

theme.cover: letterhead page without images: page 1 holds a typed placeholder for the customer logo, the patient table and a hidden control line; no header and no footer on page 1, since the first-page variants are switched on but not defined

fonts.families: theme fonts Trebuchet MS (headings) and Calibri (body); almost all runs Calibri; Wingdings for tick boxes and coloured bullets; Helvetica and Courier New only as complex-script fonts
fonts.sizes_pt: almost all 11; 10, 12, 13 and 14 in a few headings and labels

colours: dark navy accent text (headings, labels) and footer company name
beige, light grey, light green, light cyan and pale blue table shading
red, blue, green and amber symbol bullets
blue, red and dark blue legend text matching the device curve colours
white text for the hidden control line
yellow, cyan and dark green editor highlights
footer: company line (company name in a floating text box)

images.other: 12 placements of 11 static localisation pictures in the ICA component tables; 3 floating legend text boxes; a typed text placeholder instead of a logo image

theme_gaps: different first page: no header and no footer on page 1
running header with patient slots (name, birth date) and a page number field from page 2
footer as a floating text box
automatic heading numbering (roman chapters, arabic sections), used by the table of contents
78 manual page breaks and 2 page-break-before settings (start on new page as a block option is a mockup assumption)
figure width option on six map markers, written with typographic quotes
tick boxes and coloured bullets drawn with a symbol font
logo slot as typed placeholder text rather than an image slot
legend text coloured to match the fixed device curve colours
editor highlight colours left in the template

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 0, 1: quoted template prose slipped through a 5-word check that ignored hyphens
review_response.reason: Ran a 4-word check (hyphens split, markers break runs) against all XML text of all 16 raw docx, content controls, text boxes, footnotes and document properties included; no run of template prose remains in T14.

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 2: close paraphrases of fixed company sentences (spike reading, group match, recommendation lead-in, medication line)
review_response.reason: Every fixed sentence is described by its function only, for example a fixed sentence stating a match with a diagnosed group whatever the computed group.

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 5: exact brand colour values recorded
review_response.reason: Theme colours are plain colour names; no colour values.

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 6: exact use counts allow re-identification
review_response.reason: reports_per_year and share_pct come from usage_rounded.json.

review_response.finding: classify-2 3: the extractor skipped content controls
review_response.reason: Modelled from tpl_extract_v2 and the raw XML: the running header (content control) and the table of contents control now have elements.

review_response.finding: classify-2 5, numbers 0, completeness 1: items listed as not expressible were classed as covered
review_response.reason: Every element whose representation needs a schema change has class not_expressible with a gap code, and the not_expressible list names the element ids; leave_out is a separate class outside the coverage scope.

review_response.finding: classify-2 6, numbers 17: assumptions on the stress classifier and the manual ERP tables do not match the models
review_response.reason: The stress index is dropped with bio signals, since the audit shows the cardiac module always deletes its blocks; the six hand-ticked peak tables are not_expressible TG6 (rule 9) with the ERPC2 row noted as the alternative mapping.

review_response.finding: classify-2 7: fixed sentences and definitions folded into non-clinic elements
review_response.reason: Fixed verdict sentences are their own leave_out elements (rule 3). Static explanations inside out-of-scope sections take that section's class and carry claim_wording and claim_kind, one rule for all (see classify-4 16).

review_response.finding: classify-2 15: the claim denominator mixes images, slots and texts
review_response.reason: clinic_kind separates text, image, slots and header_footer, and claim_wording is set on every element, so a report can count clinic text elements only. CP run counts are not restated: only rounded usage numbers may be used.
